name: Lamb Tzatziki Burgers
assumptions: Yield estimated from explicit instruction to shape mixture into 4 burgers and serve in 4 buns.

Total time is sum of explicit instruction times (10 min bulgur boil + ~10 min for two-sided frying/barbecuing) plus ~5 min estimated for tzatziki prep, mixing, shaping, and assembly; no explicit total given.
Bulgur wheat classified as containing wheat (not gluten-free).
Greek yogurt classified as containing milk (dairy).
Buns classified as containing wheat (not gluten-free); assumed standard wheat-based buns with no contrary specification.
Olive oil, spices, garlic, cucumber, lamb mince, and mint introduce no listed allergens or dietary conflicts.
No tree nuts, peanuts, fish, shellfish, eggs, soy, or sesame in listed ingredients.
instructions:
Tip the bulghar into a pan, cover with water and boil for 10 mins. Drain really well in a sieve, pressing out any excess water.

To make the tzatziki, squeeze and discard the juice from the cucumber, then mix into the yogurt with the chopped mint and a little salt.

Work the bulghar into the lamb with the spices, garlic (if using) and seasoning, then shape into 4 burgers. Brush with a little oil and fry or barbecue for about 5 mins each side until cooked all the way through. Serve in the buns (toasted if you like) with the tzatziki, tomatoes, onion and a few mint leaves.
